attempts.summary: Configured node1 as a router between two segments (eth1: 172.20.1.0/24 to node2, eth2: 172.20.2.0/24 to node3) with IP forwarding enabled, persisted via /etc/network/interfaces.d and /etc/sysctl.d on node1 (SONiC) and via /etc/network/interfaces static stanzas on node2/node3 (Alpine). Verified node2<->node3 connectivity via node1 both before and after restarting all three nodes one at a time, confirming config and connectivity survive reboot.
